title: Embedding of pseudotensor category
summary: We realize the embedding functor from pseudotensor category to tensor category in a purely algebraic setting when the pseudotensor category is the category $\mathcal{M}(H)$ of left $H$-modules, which is originally defined by Beilinson and Drinfeld. Then we use operadic methods to construct the Schur functor and free object in the tensor category.
